items.title: What Is Texas Instruments (TXN) Launching For Factory Automation And IIoT?
items.summary: Texas Instruments (NasdaqGS:TXN) introduced new multiprotocol industrial communications devices for factory automation, robotics and IIoT systems. The hardware and software offering targets easier interoperability between different industrial protocols within complex production environments. Texas Instruments is positioning these devices to support design flexibility, cost management and integration for equipment makers and plant operators.
